Inland Revenue Department Anguilla: Goods & Services Tax (came into force 1 July 2022, 13%)
Inland Revenue Department Anguilla: General Services Tax (came into force 1 August 2025, 13% on services)
KPMG tax news flash: Anguilla — implementation of general services tax from 1 August 2025, replacing the 2022 goods and services tax; 9% import goods tax on goods

caveats: individualTaxYear is the calendar year, inferred from the country's annual assessment cycle (grade I); not confirmed on the authority's own pages in this pass.
companyYearEndDefault is a 31 December app default for new entities (grade I), not a statutory requirement; companies may choose other year ends under national law.

Anguilla had no broad consumption tax before 1 July 2022, so rate coverage starts on that date. The 13% goods and services tax was repealed on 1 August 2025 and split into a 13% General Services Tax on services and a 9% import goods tax on goods.
